subject: Cloud review of #1218, #1219, #1220: one doc fix on #1219, two should-fix guards on #1220/#1218, otherwise ship
body:
Reviewed the three new Mac PRs against the standing checklist (fail-closed, deterministic, no DecisionEngine.swift/AppWorkflows.swift change, tests that can fail, true figures).

#1219 (pg-role-split-stores @ 90a92b97): FIX before merge. docs/DEPLOYMENT.md:356 says rolling the API image back is always safe against the same schema. After this migration the runtime role has no UPDATE on decisions/evidence_snapshots, so an old image (whose assertPrivileges demands UPDATE and whose ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE needs it) against a migrated DB gives /readyz 503 and failing decision routes; the migrate-first-then-roll order at :353 has the same window for old pods mid-roll. Qualify the rollback sentence and name the window. Code otherwise fail-closed (trigger/PUBLIC/column-grant refusals, unknown status reads expired, rowCount!==1 throws). NIT: session refresh checks status='active' but not expires_at (session-store.ts:314). DECISION_PATH, so owner-merged until DR-061.

#1220 (enterprise-auth-hardening @ 3a1798c4): ship on the code, one should-fix. verifyJwtRs256 (jwt.ts:188-199) does not guard a NaN clockToleranceSec or NaN nowMs; either makes the exp comparison false and an expired token is accepted. Today config parsing and callers guard both, so only a direct caller reaches it, but it is a one-line Number.isFinite refusal at the library boundary. Also: OIDC_CLOCK_TOLERANCE_SEC has no upper cap (config.ts:84, 1e9 accepted; suggest about 300s), and the JWKS single-flight relies on the injected fetch having a timeout (context.ts AbortSignal.timeout(5000)); the cache itself has none. DECISION_PATH + SAFETY_MACHINERY, owner-merged until DR-061.

#1218 (raised-hands-owner-mac @ c762ea87): ship. Mutants confirmed the self-test can fail (dropping timed_out or skipped from the lists gives 72/73). One MEDIUM you already name in a ponytail comment: a green sim_only dispatch of mac-lane.yml as the newest decisive run hides a red full-suite run (silence, which loosens); filter the decisive run to the full-suite event. LOW: neutral/stale/action_required count as decisive but raise nothing, and ten cancelled/skipped runs read null and silent. SAFETY_MACHINERY: the cloud lands it under DR-037 on a mail ask once Mac-only is green.

On every PR today the github-advanced-security red is the Copilot scanner crashing in its own agent loop, not a finding.
